newsitem.title: UK: Laura Ashley design director quits.
newsitem.headline: Laura Ashley design director quits.

text.p: British fashion retailer Laura Ashley (Holdings) Plc said on Wednesday its director of design and buying Basha Cohen would leave the group to join U.S. fashion firm Tommy Hilfiger Corporation.
Cohen will become senior vice president of women's design and licensing at Tommy Hilfiger.
Cohen's departure marks the latest in a series of management upheavals at the firm, which is battling to revitalise flagging sales and profits.
Over the past couple of months two other senior executives have resigned, including merchandising director Julie Ramshaw.
American-born chief executive Ann Iverson, hired two years ago to turn the business around, said in a statement Cohen had made a significant contribution to "repositioning" the Laura Ashley brand.
Iverson, credited with the turnaround of British childrenswear chain Mothercare, has come under increasing pressure after Laura Ashley issued a profit warning in April.

The firm's shares have spiralled lower since April reflecting growing doubts about Iverson's ability to deliver the promised profit recovery. They stood 6.5 pence down at 49.5 pence after the announcement that Cohen was to leave.

The company also said it has appointed Ann Boyd as s non-executive director. Boyd was creative director for Ralph Lauren's European operations for 10 years, and now runs a specialist interior design company.
